params.description: If present, wpArea is a form object name (Text); if omitted, wpArea is a 4D Write Pro document (object variable or field).

params.name: wpViewProps
params.description: Object whose properties are the view properties to modify; properties not included keep their previous values.

overloads.semanticRole: Dynamically sets one or more view properties of the 4D Write Pro wpArea area, leaving unspecified properties unchanged.

constraints: The command can only be used if wpArea is associated with a form object currently displayed in the form; if the document is displayed in several form objects, the '*' syntax is required to identify which view to set.
Property modifications made by this command are not saved with the document or the form and persist only while the form area is in use and not overridden by a later call.
